symbols.name: factor bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two integers of one product given to the established multiplier (not the bank size).
symbols.quote: where $N$ is the number of bits in each factor (this $N$ is not the bank size of the exchange network)

relations.quote: The multiplier runs in the [Fixed finite-tape machine model](machine-model.md), the same model as the main result, so a call costs its $O(N\log N)$ steps with no change of machine to account for.
The multiplier is called only after the new algorithm reduces its [Fourier transforms](dft.md) to polynomial products over $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$.
